A_edge_exists.legacy_alias_notice: unit_mean_final_clv and units_beating_close are one-release compatibility aliases for the settlement-return fields; they are not true pre-event CLV.
A_edge_exists.note: Gate A measures unit mean net settlement return per dollar (pre-fee), not closing-line edge; true pre-event CLV is shown beside it and feeds no gate in this study. Units cluster finals by market AND merge markets sharing a fixture (team + settlement date), so neither correlated tokens nor same-match side markets can inflate significance.

A_edge_exists.registered_rule: Use equal-weight independent fixture units; pass only with positive unit mean net settlement return per dollar (pre-fee) and the registered one-sided sign-test threshold on settled-profitable units after the sample floor.
